component.name: QCalc
component.summary: 5 calculators, 10 languages — built for productivity and accessibility

description.p: QCalc packs 5 specialized calculators and 10 languages into one clean, keyboard-friendly app. Built with Vue 3, Quasar, and Tauri, it covers everyday arithmetic, unit conversion, currency exchange, programmer math, and formula evaluation — all one tab away.

ul.li: Standard — arithmetic, percentages, trig, powers, roots, factorial
Unit Converter — 15+ categories (length, area, volume, weight, and more)
Currency Converter — real-time exchange rates with quick adjustments
Radix Converter — binary/octal/decimal/hex with bitwise operations
Formula — type math expressions directly using mathjs syntax
Calculation history with notes and CSV export/import
10 languages — Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian
ARIA labels, screen reader announcements, keyboard focus indicators, reduced motion support
Multiple color themes, dark mode, and keyboard-first design
Settings and history export/import for consistent environments

description.p: Note for screen reader users: due to an upstream sandbox limitation, the interface is currently not exposed to assistive technologies when running as a Flatpak. Please use the .deb, .rpm or AppImage package instead.

Fixes the Snap package failing to start, restores update notifications for users still on the Electron build, removes the leftovers of that build when upgrading on Windows, and corrects window sizing under desktop text scaling and keypad label sizing on Linux.

Desktop production build switched from Electron to Tauri 2 with six package formats built in CI, activated auto-update, 2 additional languages (Portuguese, Russian) for 10 in total, screen reader announcement of results on Linux, WCAG AA contrast, improved keyboard accessibility, and undo for record deletion.
New Formula calculator, 5 additional languages (Chinese, Hindi, German, Spanish, French), Flatpak packaging, Electron 40, and accessibility improvements.
Number format per calculator feature and various bug fixes.
